build_fairseq_package: run python setup.py install to build and install the fairseq package with C++ extensions
build_fairseq_extensions: run python setup.py build_ext to compile the Cython and C++ extension modules for fairseq
clean_fairseq_build: run python setup.py clean to delete compiled Cython and shared object files from fairseq
review_numpyextension_class: review the NumpyExtension class that extends setuptools Extension to auto-include numpy headers
review_do_setup_function: review the do_setup function that configures package metadata, dependencies, and console script entry points
